title: feat(users): add privileged role tag and footnote to user editor modal
body:
This PR adds a visual indicator for privileged roles in the user edit modal.
- Adds an orange/yellow "特权角色" tag next to checkboxes for roles that have `privilegedUserDataAccess` set to true.
- Adds a footnote at the bottom of the modal explaining the tag and linking to `/who-can-see-my-data`.
